I’m on the outside looking in
telling everyone this looks like trouble 
indulge me in my god damn suffering honey
nothings gonna burst this bubble 

all the words I kept on swallowing 
now it’s changing and it’s all your fault 
listen to me when I tell you: 
that everything was fine 
the way it was 

hey, hey 
it’s a brand new day
looking right out at the station 
from the fire escape 
change, change
coming like a train
never know what you’ve got going 
‘til it’s gone away 

my life
it was calm and nice 
had some money in my pocket
and some friends I liked
gone, gone 
I’m the only one 
oh show me where it all went wrong  

I’m on the outside looking in
telling everyone this looks like trouble 
indulge me in my god damn suffering honey
nothings gonna burst this bubble 

all the words I kept on swallowing 
now it’s changing and it’s all your fault 
listen to me when I tell you: 
that everything was fine 
the way it was 

I’m on the outside looking in
watching all the air turn blue 
you said don’t make a problem where there isn’t one
I said - what if the problem’s you?

all the words I kept on swallowing 
now it’s changing and it’s all your fault 
listen to me when I tell you: 
that everything was fine 
the way it was

lyrics:
way past the honeymoon phase
yet all day 
I’m sitting, waiting for your call

can’t get enough of us
oh is it obvious

in reality I’m
at home
just crawling up the wall

now I feel ok again 
you could say anything 
you’re my favourite idiot of all

(stuck on the thought)
always running in the background
and I know you’ve got a lot to do
but I was thinking you could come round
and we could stay up talking in my room

I cancelled all of my plans 
to kiss the back of my hand
and think of you like it’s a sport 

I feel 15 again 
you could say anything 
you’re my favourite idiot of all

always running in the background
been neglecting all my basic needs 
so I was thinking you could come round
and snap me out of this dream

loser or a lover girl
could make you sick

chomping at the bit 

oh look at you 
I am sold 
the problem now is that I don’t have any control 
 
lover girl

just enough to leave you chomping at the bit
 
I look at you 
to get me off 
owning it i’m owning it

always running in the background
